lines.speaker: trainer
lines.text: This is not a story. In 1968, two scientists did this *for real.*
lines.say: This is not a story. In 1968, two scientists did this... for real.

lines.speaker: trainer
lines.text: Alone in the smoke, three people out of four got up and reported it.

lines.speaker: trainer
lines.text: With two calm strangers beside them, only *one in ten* did.
lines.say: With two calm strangers beside them... only one in ten did.

lines.speaker: trainer
lines.text: The smoke was the same. Only the faces changed.
lines.say: The smoke was the same. Only the faces... changed.

lines.speaker: trainer
lines.text: You do this too. A fire alarm rings, everyone looks around, and nobody moves first.
lines.say: You do this too. A fire alarm rings, everyone looks around... and nobody moves first.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Here is how you beat it. When something feels wrong, do not check the faces around you.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: They are checking yours. Say it out loud, and *stand up first.*
lines.say: They are checking yours. Say it out loud... and stand up first.

lines.speaker: trainer
lines.text: One person standing up breaks the whole trick.
lines.say: One person standing up, breaks the whole trick.

lines.speaker: trainer
lines.text: So how long would you sit in smoke? As long as everyone else does.
lines.say: So, how long would you sit in smoke? As long... as everyone else does.
